title: The Law Revision (Amendment) Act, 2026
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette”, Vol. 65,
No. 89, 21st May, 2026
First Session Thirteenth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 8 of 2026
[L.S.]
BILL
AN ACT to amend the Law Revision Act, Chap. 3:03
[Assented to 15th May, 2026]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Law Revision
Short title
(Amendment) Act, 2026.
2. This Act shall come into operation on such date as
Commencement
is fixed by the President by Proclamation.
3. In this Act, “the Act” means the Law Revision Act.
Interpretation
182 No. 8 Law Revision (Amendment) 2026
4. Section 2 of the Act is amended by inserting in
Section 2 amended
the appropriate alphabetical sequence, the following
definitions:
“ “designated website” means the website
specified in an Order under section 5A(1);
“electronic version of the Laws” means a written
law that is published in accordance with
section 5A(2);.
“PDF” means Portable Document Format;”.
5. The Act is amended by inserting after section 5, the
Sections 5A, 5B, and
5C inserted following sections:
5A. (1) The Minister may, by Order,
“Publication
of electronic designate a website as the sole official
versions of
the Laws website for the publication of electronic
versions of the Laws.
(2) An electronic version of the
Laws that is published on the designated
website shall be in PDF or such other
format as the Minister may, by Order,
approve.
(3) An electronic copy or printout
of an electronic version of the Laws shall,
unless the contrary is proven, be deemed
to be official and authoritative if–
(a) it is accessed or downloaded
from the designated website;
(b) it is in PDF or such other
approved format; and
(c) it meets the prescribed
requirements with respect
to–
(i) the manner in
which the electronic
copy or printout is
created, recorded,

authenticated,

or perceived; and
(ii) any statement, mark
or certification
associated with the
creation, recording,
transmission, storage,
authentication, recep-
tion, display or
perception of the
electronic copy or
printout.
(4) The Minister may make
regulations prescribing any of the matters
in subsection (3)(c).
5B. On or after the coming into opera-

versions
between the Laws published under section 5
and an electronic version of the Laws

version of the Laws shall prevail over the
Laws published under section 5 to the
extent of the inconsistency.
5C. Where a correction is made to any
Correction of
electronic electronic version of the Laws which is
version of the
Laws already published on the designated
website, the Commission shall publish on
the designated website a notice of the

6. The Act is amended in section 6, by inserting after
Section 6 amended
subsection (3), the following subsection:
“(4) This section shall not apply to an
electronic version of the Laws.”.

7. Section 15 of the Act is amended, by inserting after
Section 15 amended
the word “Laws”, the words “, including the electronic
version of the Laws published under section 5A,”.
8. Section 16 of the Act is amended in the
Section 16
amended chapeau, by inserting after the word “9” the words “or
the preparation of an electronic version of the Laws”.
